Overview

Cabo Frio is a city in RJ with a population of 234,077. A historic coastal city in the Lagos Region, famous for its crystal-clear waters, white sand beaches, and colonial salt trade history. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 250 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
